review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the relevant Mathlib lemmas: ExteriorAlgebra.prodEquivTensor_symm_tmul, prodEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul_ιMulti, and GradedTensorProduct.auxEquiv_tmul. The clear repetition is the pair of `ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_tmul` lemmas. The ιMulti-to-map conversion in the later `coe_prodEquivDirectSum_symm_of_tmul_ιMulti` proof does the same work as the ιMulti lemma. I also looked at the inl/inr branches of `prodEquivDirectSum_symm_naturality` and the by_cases blocks in `antidiagonalIncl_proj_component`. I judged those too small, or just duplicated branches, to meet the rubric, so I did not report them. I could not compile the proposed replacement, so the rewritten proof is a sketch.

findings.excerpt:
rw [ambientDirectSumEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_symm, LinearEquiv.trans_symm]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R]
  rw [TensorProduct.directSum_symm_lof_tmul]
findings.problem: The two lemmas have the same proof skeleton. Both unfold `ambientDirectSumEquiv`, split `trans_symm` twice, and rewrite `lof_eq_of` and `directSum_symm_lof_tmul`. Both then prove the same `haux` fact, that `(auxEquiv ..).symm (lof .. ⊗ₜ lof ..)` equals the graded tmul `x ᵍ⊗ₜ y`. They differ only in the final Mathlib lemma: `prodEquivTensor_symm_apply_tmul_ιMulti` for the first and `prodEquivTensor_symm_tmul` for the second. The ιMulti statement is the special case a = ιMulti p, b = ιMulti q of the general one. The file already does that conversion in `coe_prodEquivDirectSum_symm_of_tmul_ιMulti`, using `ιMulti_apply_coe`, `map_apply_ιMulti` and `ιMulti_mul_ιMulti`. The `haux` block, with its `LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq` and `auxEquiv_tmul` reasoning, is therefore written out twice, and a fix to one copy would have to be repeated in the other.
findings.proposed_change:
Keep only the general lemma `ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_tmul'` (a : ⋀[R]^i P, b : ⋀[R]^j Q), whose proof keeps the single `haux` argument. Replace the body of `ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_tmul` (the ιMulti version, used in `ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_mem`) with:
`rw [show (exteriorPower.ιMulti R i p ⊗ₜ[R] exteriorPower.ιMulti R j q) = _ from rfl, ambientDirectSumEquiv_symm_of_tmul']`
then `simp only [exteriorPower.ιMulti_apply_coe, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ιMulti]` and `exact ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti _ _`. These are the same three steps as in `coe_prodEquivDirectSum_symm_of_tmul_ιMulti`. Better still, make that conversion one small lemma, say `map_inl_ιMulti_mul_map_inr_ιMulti`, and use it in both places. The `haux` argument is then written once and the ιMulti form is derived from it.
findings.benefit: This removes about 20 lines of duplicated, `rw`-heavy proof. The core fact that the ambient equivalence sends a tensor of graded pieces to a product of images lives in one place. The ιMulti-to-map conversion is also stated once instead of in two proofs. Readers see that the ιMulti statement is a corollary, and maintenance after Mathlib API changes touches one proof.
